annotation.title_clean: Tam Otonom Araçların Otonom Sürüş Sistemine İlişkin Motorlu Araçların Tip Onayı Hakkında Yönetmelik (AB/2022/1426)
annotation.title_en: Regulation on the Type-Approval of Motor Vehicles with regard to the Automated Driving System of Fully Automated Vehicles (EU/2022/1426)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlığı (Ministry of Industry and Technology, Türkiye)
named_instruments_referenced: Turkey Product Safety and Technical Regulations Law No. 7223
annotation.summary_en: Turkish Ministry of Industry and Technology regulation (Official Gazette 1 Dec 2024) transposing EU Implementing Regulation 2022/1426. It sets type-approval procedures and technical requirements for the automated driving systems of fully automated M and N category vehicles, covering hub-to-hub, fixed-route and automated parking use cases. It also defines the roles of in-vehicle and remote intervention operators.
key_provisions_or_claims: Covers type-approval of automated driving systems in fully automated M/N vehicles for defined-area, fixed-route and automated parking uses
Defines key terms, including the automated driving system, operational design domain, minimal risk manoeuvre, in-service monitoring and the remote intervention operator
Technical requirements in Annex II are assessed by approval authorities or technical services under Annex III
In force on publication; the Minister of Industry and Technology is responsible for enforcing it
